q: Which three countries formed the Kalmar Union in 1397?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2020 exam.

da.q: Hvilke tre lande dannede Kalmarunionen i 1397?

learn.text: And in 1397 she gathered Denmark, Norway and Sweden, which at that time also included Finland, in a union with Denmark as the dominant power. This was called the Kalmar Union, because the union treaty was signed in the Swedish town of Kalmar.

q: Who gathered Denmark, Norway and Sweden in a union at the end of the 1300s?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2023 exam.

da.q: Hvem samlede i slutningen af 1300-tallet Danmark, Norge og Sverige i en union?

learn.text: After Valdemar Atterdag died in 1375, his daughter Margrete the First took power. She also became regent in Norway, which at that time included the Faroe Islands, Iceland and parts of Greenland. And in 1397 she gathered Denmark, Norway and Sweden, which at that time also included Finland, in a union with Denmark as the dominant power.
